scope.rationale: D-03 adds the two translation-only core marker types and the narrow exact-definition recognition in the core translator, plus their behaviour tests. The compiled inputs are the new core marker file, the internal translator edit and the marker test class; the affected subset is the marker class in the SQL Server test project (compile gate: the core/sqlserver build). No provider overload, dialect, builder or existing test is touched.
scope.boundary: Single post-implementation boundary planned for D-07: full per-project test sweeps plus the six-provider container integration run (C07/C08/C11); not executed by D-03. The solution-wide gate (dotnet build nextorm.slnx -c Debug = 0/0) and the legacy Pivot/Unpivot regression set are recorded as D-03 provenance logs, not as inner report executions.
